setup_and_measurement_corrections.cause: New UDP argument self-test compared 11 suffix arguments with a 10-item expected list; corrected the assertion. No workload had started.

Original native switch timing classifier recognized only UDP source port46000. Five initial multi-flow acquisitions matched sender/entry counts; the eight-flow prefix acquisition had17 fewer packets at entry. Native timing was absent for all six. Removed source-port restriction for the fixed isolated noise IP/target/UDP-length; fixed native and socket regression passed. Rebooted four disposable guests to reconnect and repeated the acquisitions without weakening gates.

Cleanup tried nft on the sender guest, which has no nft utility and received no nft rules. Restricted table assertions to the three guests that use nft; made owned observer-table deletion repeatable, then completed rollback and shutdown.

scope: Four fresh disposable COW guests only. The lab switch classifier now observes every source port from the isolated noise IP/target/length; forwarding is unchanged. No changes to live servers, user VPN, Windows networking, WSL, public filter source, guard policy, default installers or GitHub. Counts before and after the guard separate client losses from queue losses.
interpretation_limits: Both native AWG client profiles share one 1-vCPU VM; client CPU saturation is reported separately and fails the all-VM CPU gate.
UDP application payload PPS differs from outer AWG datagram PPS; per-tuple outer skb packet/byte counts and independent iperf sender/receiver summaries are retained.
iperf omission boundaries can produce slightly different sender/receiver packet totals; packet-count equality is not forced.
Noise flows differ by source UDP port on one source IP; distributed source IPs, adaptive attacks and set exhaustion are not tested.
Trials are bounded 70-second loads, not hours-long endurance or real VPS capacity.
CPU acceptance uses nominal 250-ms samples and four-sample windows, not an instantaneous hardware cap.
Header admission does not authenticate a peer; the exit authenticates VPN traffic.
